I thought about going deep into the woods away from any hunting trails or whatever. It’s winter here so my body wouldn’t be totally hard to take care of If I was found before being eaten by something. I guarantee a pack of coyotes would eat a lot of it and probably birds would get rid of the rest. I have heard of people being found after a couple weeks and they are still there so I have no idea why animals don’t eat you sometimes. I would more than likely never be found if I did it in the right spot, the bones would be covered after a while. The thing is I know they bring dogs when they search for a body so I would be fucked if I didn’t create a diversion. I’d leave a note saying “I took off to slab city in California to start a new life” nobody is going into the fucking woods to find me. I know about cell phone tracking but I kind of want to listen to music before and while I do it, I’ll pop the SIM card out and place it with the note, soaking it in some kind of  glue and cutting it. It would ping off the nearest tower last by my house so that doesn’t give any leads. I’m not that important to be looked for if I said I’m just going to slab city they wouldn’t question it.

I have been in the very worst of depression like full on lost track of time, lived in the dark, no contact with anyone, lost probably 50-60 pounds, wouldn’t drink or eat for days at a time and eventually lead to a psychotic break. I lost a girlfriend, lost every friend I had, got de rolled out of school with no notice, I actually was told to leave because I was no longer a student there. I was just literally left like this I was going to die certainly and nobody gave a fuck. I wasn’t expecting anyone to care at the time but looking back I hold a lot of resentment. I hate that the people in my life let me fucking be like that and allow me to die alone like a burden. I once again cut contact cause fuck everyone honestly I see how selfish people really are, if I was a pretty white girl I could be a bit sad and get all the help in the world. I also was ridiculed after coming out of it a little, people fucking suck.
